dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge displays a deep, concave spline curvature originating from the posterior insertion point and sweeping toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point exhibits a rounded geometry with a gradual pixel radius transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at a steep diagonal angle relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentations or nicks are visible along the lower posterior trailing edge; light-colored mottled patches are present on the lower lateral surface of the fin and body.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white and grey mottled pigmentation pattern concentrated at the ventral region of the fin base.
